name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) is hard because 'Open the door' is an unconditional command and the box step is only preferred, so door_open is the lone commanded step. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is hard because the 'then' order sits outside the 'if possible' cue, which covers only the box step. Existence(target_picked_up) is soft for the preferred box pickup. No clause is added, missing, or redundant.

texts: Open the door: the door must be open at some point.
Then: picking up the box in the other room (target_picked_up) must not happen before the door has been opened.
If possible: pick up the box in the other room, which is the mission's target box.
